description: Change PDF info fields (title, author, subject, keywords, creator, producer, dates, custom fields) or strip all metadata: info fields, XMP, page-level data and the document ID, and drop unreachable leftovers from earlier edits so no trace stays in the bytes. Untouched values keep their exact original form. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-metadata/

author.description: Author. "" removes it; omit to keep it.

creationDate.description: Creation date as ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-03-14T09:30:00+03:00". "" removes it; omit to keep it.

creator.description: Creator (the app that made it). "" removes it; omit to keep it.

custom.description: Custom info fields to set; null removes one. E.g. {"Company": null}.

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

keywords.description: Keywords. "" removes it; omit to keep it.

modDate.description: Modification date as ISO 8601. "" removes it; omit to keep it.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

producer.description: Producer (the PDF engine). "" removes it; omit to keep it.

removeDocumentId.description: Remove the document ID from the trailer.

removeXmp.description: Remove the XMP metadata stream (and page-level XMP/PieceInfo).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

strip.description: Remove ALL metadata (other edits are ignored).

subject.description: Subject. "" removes it; omit to keep it.

title.description: Title. "" removes it; omit to keep it.

name: pdf_metadata_write
title: Edit or strip PDF metadata
